description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Stacked Line Chart Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 25, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Main functions: 1. Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive stacked line charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. 2. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. 3. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. 4. Responsive design: Stacked line charts can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. 5. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: -Sales analysis: Display the sales trends and cumulative effects of different products or services over time. -Financial report: displays monthly or quarterly changes in different financial indicators of the company. -Resource utilization: Display the usage and cumulative effects of resources at different time periods. -Performance monitoring: Display the changes and cumulative trends of system performance indicators over time.
